text:
maria (product): quick sync — ClearBank pilot asked for a tiered burst SLA specifically for payments routes. They want: guaranteed burst for /v1/pay, softer for /v1/recon, preemption windows, and explicit billing for burst usage. need to decide scope before EOW.

sam (eng-platform): do we have a mapping of route -> token weight for their traffic? if not, suggest we default to route buckets + priority tags.

maria (product): no weight map yet, jordan is owning pricing with the customer. but we need an engineering ask: how much effort to add per-route priority and a soft vs hard burst band?

jordan (sales): customer story: they will pay for a guaranteed burst up to X tps for /v1/pay during settlement windows. main ask is predictable latency on that route. they also want a buffer for spikes.

priya (eng-sre): prioritization-wise we can do three soundings: (1) reserved pool with strict token reservation for critical routes, (2) soft-burst layered on top with preemption, (3) fallback to a cheaper model variant if capacity exhausted. question: do we want preemption by tenant or by route?

sam (eng-platform): preempt-by-route is easiest to reason about for SLAs. we can mark tokens with priority tag at request time and schedule prefer-high when batching. low-priority gets queued or served by fallback.

leo (customer-success): ClearBank will accept route-level preemption as long as we offer a clear SLA doc and a monthly burst invoice line item. they asked for a sample contract clause.

maria (product): action items: 1) eng to estimate work for per-route priority + soft/hard burst behavior, 2) product to draft SLA language + sample invoice line, 3) cs/sales to confirm acceptable preemption semantics.

sam (eng-platform): estimate: 5–8 engineering days to wire priority tags through routing + scheduler changes, + 2 days to add telemetry and per-route counters. autoscale policy changes maybe another 3 days to add 'priority-aware' cooldowns. total ~10–13d.

priya (eng-sre): ops caveat: need tracing + alerts to detect silent degradation of low-priority routes. recommend a canary and a kill-switch for the preemption logic.

maria (product): good. can we prototype with a config like below to validate behavior in sandbox? if yes, sam/priya please spin one up.

sam (eng-platform): yep — will stand up prototype in dev region. config sketch:
```
priority_bands:
  - name: critical
    routes: ["/v1/pay"]
    guaranteed_tokens_per_min: 60000
    preemption: hard
  - name: background
    routes: ["/v1/recon"]
    guaranteed_tokens_per_min: 5000
    preemption: soft
scheduler:
  mode: priority_aware
  batch_window_ms: 8
```

priya (eng-sre): for monitoring, add these queries to dashboards:
- p50/p95 latency by route and priority band
- token_consumption_per_route per minute
- preemption_count and fallback_count

jordan (sales): i'll draft invoice line: "Burst capacity (route /v1/pay): guaranteed X tokens/min during settlement windows; excess usage billed at Y per 1k tokens." will share with legal.

leo (customer-success): requested checkbox: ability to opt out of preemption during specific dates (e.g., regulatory testing). we should surface that in the onboarding flow.

maria (product): that implies a calendar flag in the pool config — fine. add to scope if low lift.

ops-bot: deployment scheduled to dev-sandbox at 2025-07-18T09:00:00Z (simulated). :rocket:

sam (eng-platform): timeline proposal: prototype this week, internal alpha next week, and customer pilot in 3 weeks if no major regressions.

priya (eng-sre): gating criteria for pilot: telemetry present, rollback toggle, per-route quota export to billing, and SLO dashboards.

maria (product): OK. i'll collate and make a JIRA epic. assigning eng estimate to sam/priya, SLA doc to jordan, onboarding checkbox to leo. aiming for decision + go/no-go by Fri 17:00.

jordan (sales): noted. will sync with ClearBank and get confirmation on the X/Y numbers today.

leo (customer-success): i'll add the onboarding checkbox UI request to backlog with low/med priority.

sam (eng-platform): any objections to using soft fallback to a smaller quantized model for background routes when preempted? reduces latency spike risk.

maria (product): seems fine as long as we include quality regression guardrails in the SLA. add to scope of Optimize recommendations.

priya (eng-sre): adding one more risk: billing accuracy for burst usage needs reconciliation tests. don't want customers disputing invoices. please add billing validation to gating checklist.

maria (product): added. thanks.

(brief emoji thread)
maria (product): :white_check_mark: action plan recorded. I'll post the epic link shortly.
